mapper.select: select g.id as id, g.user_id as userId, u.username as username, u.avatar as avatar, g.story_title as storyTitle, g.story_summary as storySummary, g.story_content as storyContent, g.is_public as isPublic, date_format(g.published_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishedTime, p.company_name as companyName, p.position_name as positionName, p.city as city, date_format(p.entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as entryTime, date_format(g.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, date_format(g.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from osh_internal_member_growth_story g inner join osh_user u on u.id = g.user_id and u.delete_flag = 0 left join osh_internal_member_employment_profile p on p.user_id = g.user_id and p.delete_flag = 0 where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.delete_flag = 0 limit 1

select g.id as id, g.user_id as userId, u.username as username, u.avatar as avatar, g.story_title as storyTitle, g.story_summary as storySummary, g.story_content as storyContent, g.is_public as isPublic, date_format(g.published_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as publishedTime, p.company_name as companyName, p.position_name as positionName, p.city as city, date_format(p.entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as entryTime, date_format(g.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, date_format(g.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from osh_internal_member_growth_story g inner join osh_user u on u.id = g.user_id and u.delete_flag = 0 and u.status = 0 inner join osh_internal_member_employment_profile p on p.user_id = g.user_id and p.delete_flag = 0 and (p.job_status = 2 or p.entry_time is not null) and p.resume_file_key is not null and p.resume_file_key != '' and p.offer_file_key is not null and p.offer_file_key != '' where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.delete_flag = 0 and g.is_public = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into osh_internal_member_growth_story ( user_id, story_title, story_summary, story_content, facts_json, generate_status, is_public, published_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, delete_flag ) values ( #{userId}, #{storyTitle}, #{storySummary}, #{storyContent}, #{factsJson}, #{generateStatus}, #{isPublic}, str_to_date(#{publishedTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0 )
mapper.update: update osh_internal_member_growth_story set story_title = #{storyTitle}, story_summary = #{storySummary}, story_content = #{storyContent}, facts_json = #{factsJson}, generate_status = #{generateStatus}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and delete_flag = 0

update osh_internal_member_growth_story set is_public = #{isPublic}, published_time = case when #{isPublic} = 1 then now() else null end, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and delete_flag = 0
